title: Prayer That Perseveres
opening: Jesus encouraged His followers to pray and not give up. Prayer brings our needs honestly before God and helps us receive His peace and wisdom.
points: Speak honestly to God about your concerns and needs.
Keep praying while also taking wise, responsible steps.
Trust God with the outcome and seek support from mature, caring believers when needed.
reflection: What concern can you bring to God today instead of carrying it alone?
prayer: Father, help me to pray faithfully, receive Your peace, and act with wisdom while I wait for Your direction. Amen.
ministry: Grace Fire Deliverance Healing Global Word Ministry
